info.name: Photosphere Tours
info.summary: 360° walkthroughs on a floor plan, with a timeline
info.description:
Turns a folder of 360° panoramas into a walkthrough: click the file `360-Rundgang.json` and the panorama opens together with the floor plan and all capture points on it. A timeline shows earlier captures of the same spot.
Everything is stored in that one JSON file next to the images – no database, it syncs with the desktop client and works through public share links (read-only).
Based on [Photo Sphere Viewer for Nextcloud](https://github.com/nextcloud/files_photospheres) by Robin Windey. Works alongside that app: single images keep opening in its viewer.
